welcome: Welcome to Family Gest. You can add an event, shopping items, a dish, an absence, a presence or a guest. What would you like to do?
reprompt: What would you like to do?
help: For example, you can say: add dentist on Tuesday at 3 PM. Add milk and eggs to the shopping list. Put lasagne on Thursday for dinner. Paul will be away tomorrow for lunch. Leah will be home tonight. Or: Granny is coming for dinner on Saturday. What would you like to do?
notUnderstood: Sorry, I didn't understand. Say "help" for examples.
error: Sorry, something went wrong. Please try again in a moment.

member.unknown: I don't know anyone called {name} in the family. Who do you mean?
member.ambiguous: Several people match {name}: {names}. Who do you mean?

shopping.askItems: What should I add to the shopping list?
shopping.done: I added {items} to the shopping list.
shopping.already: {items} is already on the list. | {items} are already on the list.
